mnd13:156.1: na kappiyo nūparato na patthiyoti bhagavāti -
mnd13:156.7: taṇhākappassa pahīnattā diṭṭhikappassa paṭinissaṭṭhatā taṇhākappaṃ vā diṭṭhikappaṃ vā na kappeti na janeti na sañjaneti na nibbatteti nābhinibbattetīti -
mnd13:156.10: sabbe bālaputhujjanā rajjanti, kalyāṇaputhujjanaṃ upādāya sabbe sekhā appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya āramanti viramanti paṭiviramanti; arahā ārato virato paṭivirato nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharatīti -
mnd13:156.14: yo rāgo sārāgo …pe… abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ.
mnd13:156.15: yassesā patthanā taṇhā pahīnā samucchinnā vūpasantā paṭippassaddhā abhabbuppattikā ñāṇagginā daḍḍhā, so vuccati na patthiyo;
mnd13:157.12: bhaji vā bhagavā araññe vanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppānīti bhagavā,
mnd13:157.14: bhāgī vā bhagavā attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa adhisīlassa adhicittassa adhipaññāyāti bhagavā,
mnd13:157.15: bhāgī vā bhagavā catuṇṇaṃ jhānānaṃ catuṇṇaṃ appamaññānaṃ catuṇṇaṃ arūpasamāpattīnanti bhagavā
mnd13:157.16: bhāgī vā bhagavā aṭṭhannaṃ vimokkhānaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ abhibhāyatanānaṃ anupubbavihārasamāpattīnanti bhagavā,
mnd13:157.17: bhāgī vā bhagavā dasannaṃ saññābhāvanānaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇasamāpattīnaṃ ānāpānasatisamādhissa asubhasamāpattiyāti bhagavā,
mnd13:157.18: bhāgī vā bhagavā catuṇṇaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ catuṇṇaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ catuṇṇaṃ iddhipādānaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ pañcannaṃ balānaṃ sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassāti bhagavā,
mnd13:157.19: bhāgī vā bhagavā dasannaṃ tathāgatabalānaṃ catunnaṃ vesārajjānaṃ catuṇṇaṃ paṭisambhidānaṃ channaṃ abhiññāñāṇānaṃ channaṃ buddhadhammānanti bhagavā,
mnd13:157.20: bhagavāti netaṃ nāmaṃ mātarā kataṃ, na pitarā kataṃ, na bhātarā kataṃ, na bhaginiyā kataṃ na mittāmaccehi kataṃ, na ñātisālohitehi kataṃ, na samaṇabrāhmaṇehi kataṃ, na devatāhi kataṃ,
mnd13:157.21: vimokkhantikametaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutañāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavāti -
mnd13:157.22: na kappiyo nūparato na patthiyoti bhagavāti.
mnd13:159.2: yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā,
